budgetBasis: The retained approximately 0.92 million unique proxy tokens supply real technical prose and C input at a reproducible small input scale. This is an input pipeline and tokenizer experiment budget, not a statistical language-quality or production pretraining budget. Declare these limits before the new supplement is rendered or compared with protected data.
retention: Retain immutable source, notice, decision, exclusion and release bytes locally; owner backup/restore acceptance remains required for later tokenizer/model release.
deletionProcedure: Revoke affected input use through a versioned revocation ledger, enumerate source-impact and dependent artifacts, rebuild under a new release ID. Preserve old audit bytes without in-place edits.
